tools.name: list_operations
tools.description: Lists every operation of the API (operationId, HTTP method, path, summary), grouped by tag. Then call get_operation for one operation's full details.

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: Full details of one API operation: description, parameters, request body fields, every response and JSON examples (the same text as its section of /llms-full.txt). Pass its operationId from list_operations (e.g. GetCheck), or 'METHOD /path'.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Searches the integration guide, error catalog, changelog, operations and webhooks. Returns the best-matching sections with a snippet and a link; read one in full with get_guide_section, get_error, get_operation or get_webhook.

tools.name: get_error
tools.description: One error code from the error catalog: its HTTP status, what it means, what to do, and whether a retry is safe. Pass the `code` from a problem details body (e.g. client_not_found).

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: Lists every webhook event we send (event name and summary). Then call get_webhook for its fields and an example payload.

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description: One webhook event: when it is sent, its payload fields and an example (e.g. check.updated). Signature, retry and ordering rules are in the guide's webhooks section.

tools.name: get_guide_section
tools.description: One section of the integration guide, by heading or number (e.g. 'Webhooks', '9', 'Testing in the sandbox'). Without a match, lists the sections.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_error" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
